summary: Convert the declared legacy species deck into thermal, Debye, plasma and signed gyro scales; preserve explicit ES and EM unit conventions.

identity.direction: Declared inputs to named scientific outputs.
identity.definition: ES1D normalized scales: vts=sqrt(2T/m), lambdaDs=sqrt(T/(n q²)), kDs=1/lambdaDs, wps=sqrt(n q²/m). ES3D uses Tparallel in those scales, Omega=B0*q/m, and rho=sqrt(Tperp/m)/abs(Omega); B0 is a signed normalized input with default1, not a tesla label. EM constants are exactly qe=1.6022e-19 C, me=9.1094e-31 kg, c=2.9979e8 m/s, epsilon0=8.8542e-12 F/m and kB=1.3807e-23 J/K; c2=c² and mu0=1/(c² epsilon0). EM q=deck_q*qe, m=deck_m*me, Tz/p[K]=deck_Tz/p[eV]*qe/kB, vd=deck_vd*c. Then vtz=sqrt(2 kB Tz/m), lambdaD=sqrt(epsilon0 kB Tz/(n q²)), wp=sqrt(n q²/(m epsilon0)), signed Omega=B0*q/m and signed rho=sqrt(kB Tp/m)/Omega. Source normalizers explicitly use wci=abs(Omega_second), wpi=sqrt(n_first*q_second²/(m_second*epsilon0)), cwp=c/wpi, mu0 above; these are not silently replaced by another species reference. Outputs also include beta_z/p=2mu0*n*kB*Tz/p/B0², vA=B0/sqrt(mu0 sum m*n), cS=sqrt(2min(kB*Tz)/max(m)), vAwp=vA/wci. This normalized ES/SI EM parsing is distinct from the eight-column m/mp loss-cone initialization and from the maintained fluid wavevector-at-fixed-frequency relations.
identity.model: ES1D or ES3D normalized Gaussian species, or EM SI drifting bi-Maxwellian species using the exact listed legacy constants; no loss-cone branch implied.
identity.geometry: Homogeneous plasma with background field along z; k=(kx,0,kz) where applicable.
identity.coordinates: ES density/charge/mass/temperature and B0 are source-normalized inputs with the explicit algebra above; no unstated physical reference is inferred. EM B0 in tesla and signed drift in units of c; mass in electron masses.
identity.boundary: Periodic/infinite homogeneous plane-wave response; finite numerical harmonic/pole representation explicitly declared.
assumptions: A numerical spectrum is not automatically a physically certified mode.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Select es1d, es3d or em frequency relation.
inputs.constraints: Explicit model selection; no implicit conversion between ES and EM deck conventions.

inputs.name: deck
inputs.description: Explicit species table; use default_deck(model) to obtain the packaged table. ES1D columns q,m,n,T,vd. ES3D q,m,n,Tparallel,Tperp,vd. EM q/e,m/me,n,Tparallel,Tperp,vd/c.
inputs.units: ES dimensionless normalized quantities; EM n in m^-3, T in eV, mass in electron masses.
inputs.shape: Sx5 for es1d; Sx6 for es3d/em
inputs.constraints: Nonzero charge; positive mass,density,temperatures; EM S>=2 for declared second-species normalizers. Finite after float64 narrowing. None is rejected by this direct operator; only ordered_spectrum owns automatic default-deck selection.

inputs.name: B0
inputs.description: Signed background field along z; None selects ES3D1 or EM100e-9. ES1D has no field.
inputs.constraints: Relevant magnetized field finite and nonzero; no inferred unmagnetized substitute. ES3D Omega_s=B0*q_s/m_s.

outputs.name: state
outputs.description: Named source scales: ES1D S,qs,ms,ns0,Ts,vs0,vts,lambdaDs,kDs,wps; ES3D uses Tzs,Tps,vtzs and adds signed wcs plus absolute rhocs. EM additionally retains original deck quantities, wps2,lmdT,betasz,betasp,vA,cS,wci,wpi,cwp,vAwp,c2,epsilon0,mu0,kB. Binary64 arrays keep their source row shapes.
outputs.units: Model-dependent ES dimensionless or EM SI.
outputs.constraints: Binary64 arrays preserve source row shapes; use named fields rather than inferred positional scales.

outputs.name: receipt
outputs.description: Frozen Python execution receipt for an executed pure-Python operator; execution provenance is separate from scientific validity.
outputs.constraints: Execution provenance does not certify scientific validity by itself.

preconditions: Constituent inputs finite and representable in declared numeric ports.
excluded: Zero B magnetized normalization requires a separate unmagnetized relation.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for invalid model/deck, nonphysical charge/mass/density/temperature, magnetized B0=0 or unrepresentable float64 input.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Python numerical errors propagate with operation context; no source-runtime, checkout or network fallback.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: FloatingPointError if derived equilibrium scales are nonfinite; no root solver is used.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No successful result is returned if this operation raises; no partial scientific return is promised.

example.description: Convert a representative species deck with the pure-Python equilibrium operator.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.dispersion.rational import equilibrium
r = equilibrium('em', [[-1, 1, 1e6, 100, 100, 0], [1, 1836, 1e6, 100, 100, 0]], B0=1e-7)
assert r['state']['S'].item() == 2
example.expected: PASS: .venv/bin/python computes the declared state on macOS without the declared local Python runtime.

scope: Current SciRel implementation and the repository tests listed in this contract cover the declared public ports and numerical relation.
The example exercises one bounded representative case; it does not extend applicability beyond the declared preconditions.
The pure-Python implementation runs directly on macOS without the declared local Python runtime.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct tests establish the declared contract where they run; the pure-Python example and bounded acceptance run on this macOS host. No release or human scientific approval is implied.
